head_commit.message:
fix(arch): consumer-edge anchor tracks val->text rename in gui/main.rkt run-prompt!

f68aebb1 renamed the loop variable but the ledger anchor and pinned
edge digest were not updated, so test-session-lifecycle-characterization
failed the check-locator probe and kept Release RED.

- ledger anchor: gui/main.rkt:run-prompt! sess val -> sess text
- expected-edge-digest recomputed (exit/probe digests unchanged)
